items.summary:
Trên thị trường quốc tế, giá xăng dầu hôm nay 10/11/2026 tiếp tục lao dốc trong phiên giao dịch ngày 9/11. giá dầu Brent ghi nhận mức giảm mạnh nhất trong nhiều tuần, xuống vùng thấp nhất kể từ cuối tháng 8. Trong khi đó, dầu WTI cũng chịu áp lực bán đáng kể.

[...] ## Giá xăng dầu hôm nay 10/11/2026 tiếp tục chịu áp lực giảm trên thị trường quốc tế khi dầu Brent mất gần 6% trong phiên giao dịch đầu tuần, xuống mức thấp nhất kể từ cuối tháng 8. Dầu WTI của Mỹ cũng giảm hơn 4%, trong bối cảnh triển vọng căng thẳng giữa Washington và Tehran hạ nhiệt, đồng thời nguồn cung dầu toàn cầu có dấu hiệu vượt nhu cầu. Ở thị trường trong nước, giá xăng dầu vẫn duy trì theo mức điều chỉnh giảm mạnh từ ngày 5/11. Xăng E5 RON92 hiện có giá tối đa 20.898 đồng/lít, xăng [...] Nhìn chung, giá xăng dầu hôm nay 10/11/2026 đang ghi nhận xu hướng giảm rõ rệt trên thị trường thế giới, trong khi giá bán lẻ trong nước vẫn áp dụng mức điều chỉnh từ ngày 5/11. Người tiêu dùng và doanh nghiệp vận tải nên tiếp tục theo dõi diễn biến dầu Brent, WTI cùng thông báo điều hành của liên Bộ Công Thương - Tài chính để chủ động kế hoạch chi tiêu nhiên liệu.

items.title: Giá xăng dầu hôm nay 10/11: Thế giới giảm, trong nước điều chỉnh
items.summary:
Giá xăng dầu hôm nay (10/11) trên thị trường thế giới giảm mạnh sau khi Tổng thống Mỹ Donald Trump phát tín hiệu hạn chế không kích Iran. Trong nước, giá xăng dầu đang chờ được điều chỉnh.

## Giá dầu thế giới hôm nay

Giá dầu quốc tế trong phiên giao dịch đầu tuần (9/11) giảm mạnh, giá dầu Brent về sát 90 USD/thùng.

Chốt phiên giao dịch 9/11, theo Reuters, giá dầu Brent giảm 5,85%, xuống còn 92,57 USD/thùng. Còn giá dầu WTI hạ 4,38%, chốt phiên ở mức 86,85 USD/thùng. [...] Đầu phiên giao dịch hôm nay (10/11), giá dầu WTI tiếp tục đi xuống.

Theo dữ liệu từ Oilprice, vào lúc 6h22' ngày 10/11 (giờ Việt Nam), giá dầu Brent vẫn được niêm yết ở mức 92,57 USD/thùng. Trong khi giá dầu WTI được điều chỉnh xuống mức 86,22 USD/thùng, giảm 0,73% so với phiên liền trước. [...] Theo kỳ điều hành ngày 5/11, giá bán lẻ tối đa của xăng E5RON92 giảm 2.305 đồng/lít, từ 23.203 đồng/lít xuống 20.898 đồng/lít.

Giá xăng E10RON95-III cũng hạ 2.075 đồng/lít, từ 23.231 đồng/lít xuống còn 21.156 đồng/lít.

Tương tự, giá dầu diesel 0.05S giảm 180 đồng/lít, từ 28.876 đồng/lít xuống còn 28.696 đồng/lít.

Trong khi giá dầu mazut 180CST 3.5S hạ 1.969 đồng/kg, từ 23.974 đồng/kg xuống còn 22.005 đồng/kg.

items.title: Giá xăng dầu hôm nay 10/11: Thế giới giảm, trong nước điều chỉnh
items.summary:
Giá xăng dầu hôm nay (10/11) trên thị trường thế giới giảm mạnh sau khi Tổng thống Mỹ Donald Trump phát tín hiệu hạn chế không kích Iran. Trong nước, giá xăng dầu đang chờ được điều chỉnh.

## Giá dầu thế giới hôm nay

Giá dầu quốc tế trong phiên giao dịch đầu tuần (9/11) giảm mạnh, giá dầu Brent về sát 90 USD/thùng.

Chốt phiên giao dịch 9/11, theo Reuters, giá dầu Brent giảm 5,85%, xuống còn 92,57 USD/thùng. Còn giá dầu WTI hạ 4,38%, chốt phiên ở mức 86,85 USD/thùng. [...] Đầu phiên giao dịch hôm nay (10/11), giá dầu WTI tiếp tục đi xuống.

Theo dữ liệu từ Oilprice, vào lúc 6h22' ngày 10/11 (giờ Việt Nam), giá dầu Brent vẫn được niêm yết ở mức 92,57 USD/thùng. Trong khi giá dầu WTI được điều chỉnh xuống mức 86,22 USD/thùng, giảm 0,73% so với phiên liền trước. [...] Theo kỳ điều hành ngày 5/11, giá bán lẻ tối đa của xăng E5RON92 giảm 2.305 đồng/lít, từ 23.203 đồng/lít xuống 20.898 đồng/lít.

Giá xăng E10RON95-III cũng hạ 2.075 đồng/lít, từ 23.231 đồng/lít xuống còn 21.156 đồng/lít.

Tương tự, giá dầu diesel 0.05S giảm 180 đồng/lít, từ 28.876 đồng/lít xuống còn 28.696 đồng/lít.

Trong khi giá dầu mazut 180CST 3.5S hạ 1.969 đồng/kg, từ 23.974 đồng/kg xuống còn 22.005 đồng/kg.

items.title: Donald Trump talks Iran, Pete Hegseth and Dana White at impromptu briefing
items.summary:
The president took a wide range of questions on foreign policy, including Iran, Russia and Cuba. He addressed allegations of Chinese spying on Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang and lashed out at critics of Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth, who is facing an impeachment vote in the House.

Here are five takeaways from the president’s impromptu press conference:

## No imminent action in Iran [...] Trump downplayed renewing major military operations against Iran but signaled no end to the more than eight-month war. The president said he was maintaining a naval blockade against Iran, escalating a land blockade — dubbing it Operation Iron Gate — and offering protection to U.S. allies in the region.

Trump said the war was “ending quickly,” but added, “we want to take care of people that have been very good to us over the years.” [...] Trump claimed Hegseth “won” two wars, referring to the U.S. military operation to snatch Venezuelan leader Nicolas Maduro and the conflict against Iran.

The president also said he would stand by Hegseth even if the Pentagon chief is impeached by the House of Representatives, an effort that will have massive Democratic Party backing.

“Yeah, I’ll stand by,” the president said in a response to a question from a reporter.

“He won two wars. He was in charge. We all won,” Trump said.

items.title: WATCH: Trump says FBI is looking into Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's affair with alleged Chinese agent | PBS News
items.summary:
# WATCH: Trump says FBI is looking into Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's affair with alleged Chinese agent

WASHINGTON (AP) — President Donald Trump said Monday that Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang should not worry about the FBI looking into his affair with a woman alleged to be a Chinese government agent.

President Donald Trump responded to spy plot allegations involving Nvidia's CEO in a White House briefing Monday. Watch his remarks in the player above. [...] "I did speak to him today just to see if he's feeling all right, how you're doing," Trump said. "He said he had absolutely no idea that the person in question was a spy."

President Donald Trump spoke about Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's affair with an alleged Chinese spy in a briefing Monday.

Trump is slated to meet next week with Chinese leader Xi Jinping in Shenzhen, China, at the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit, but he was noncommittal about bringing up the situation with Xi. [...] Huang has lobbied Washington to loosen limits on sales of Nvidia chips to China in recent years, winning U.S. President Donald Trump's approval for selling its H200 chips this year. It's unclear if Beijing would allow Chinese companies to buy those chips in large quantities. Nvidia said in a regulatory filing in August that it has sold only a small amount to China as such sales are restricted by the Chinese government.

items.title: Rubio says Trump's war against Iran not 'necessarily popular' but needed to stop a nuclear threat | Arkansas Advocate
items.summary:
U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio, U.S. President Donald Trump and U.S. Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth attend a Cabinet meeting at the White House on April 30, 2025 in Washington, D.C. (Photo by Andrew Harnik/Getty Images)

HOMESTEAD AIR RESERVE BASE, Fla. (AP) — Secretary of State Marco Rubio said Sunday that President Donald Trump launched the war against Iran even if it was not “necessarily popular” to safeguard the world from the country’s nuclear ambitions. [...] Trump told reporters Sunday that Vance was right about the war’s impact on the election — other than that his vice president should have also insisted it was the correct choice to go to war.

“I can tell you if I had it to do again, this historically — for history — will go down as one of the best things we ever did,” Trump said. “Because if they ever had a nuclear weapon, they would blow up the world.” [...] He reiterated that Trump prefers a diplomatic solution, but “right now, it hasn’t been very productive because the Iranian demands are simply not just unacceptable, but in some cases outrageous and ridiculous and really not realistic.”

Trump is set to meet Qatari Prime Minister Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al Thani at the White House on Monday, according to his official schedule.

items.title: Trump to meet Iran war mediator Qatar, no imminent deal seen to end the war | Reuters
items.summary:

[...] More than eight months into the conflict he launched alongside Israel on February 28, Trump has played down the likelihood of major warfare restarting soon but remains unwilling to accept an existing Iranian truce plan.

President Donald Trump responded to spy plot allegations involving Nvidia's CEO in a White House briefing Monday. Watch his remarks in the player above. [...] "I did speak to him today just to see if he's feeling all right, how you're doing," Trump said. "He said he had absolutely no idea that the person in question was a spy."

President Donald Trump spoke about Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's affair with an alleged Chinese spy in a briefing Monday.

Trump is slated to meet next week with Chinese leader Xi Jinping in Shenzhen, China, at the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit, but he was noncommittal about bringing up the situation with Xi. [...] Huang has lobbied Washington to loosen limits on sales of Nvidia chips to China in recent years, winning U.S. President Donald Trump's approval for selling its H200 chips this year. It's unclear if Beijing would allow Chinese companies to buy those chips in large quantities. Nvidia said in a regulatory filing in August that it has sold only a small amount to China as such sales are restricted by the Chinese government.

items.title: Rubio says Trump's war against Iran not 'necessarily popular' but needed to stop a nuclear threat | Arkansas Advocate
items.summary:
U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio, U.S. President Donald Trump and U.S. Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth attend a Cabinet meeting at the White House on April 30, 2025 in Washington, D.C. (Photo by Andrew Harnik/Getty Images)

HOMESTEAD AIR RESERVE BASE, Fla. (AP) — Secretary of State Marco Rubio said Sunday that President Donald Trump launched the war against Iran even if it was not “necessarily popular” to safeguard the world from the country’s nuclear ambitions. [...] Trump told reporters Sunday that Vance was right about the war’s impact on the election — other than that his vice president should have also insisted it was the correct choice to go to war.

“I can tell you if I had it to do again, this historically — for history — will go down as one of the best things we ever did,” Trump said. “Because if they ever had a nuclear weapon, they would blow up the world.” [...] He reiterated that Trump prefers a diplomatic solution, but “right now, it hasn’t been very productive because the Iranian demands are simply not just unacceptable, but in some cases outrageous and ridiculous and really not realistic.”

Trump is set to meet Qatari Prime Minister Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al Thani at the White House on Monday, according to his official schedule.

items.title: Trump to meet Iran war mediator Qatar, no imminent deal seen to end the war | Reuters
items.summary:
CAIRO/ABU DHABI, Nov 9 (Reuters) - US ​President Donald Trump will meet the prime minister of key mediator Qatar on Monday as efforts to end the Iran war ramp up following last week's ‌midterm elections, though senior US and Gulf officials cast doubt on the chances of an imminent deal. [...] More than eight months into the conflict he launched alongside Israel on February 28, Trump has played down the likelihood of major warfare restarting soon but remains unwilling to accept an existing Iranian truce plan.
